SHIVAMOGGA CITY - 577002.
...RESPONDENTS

THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED: 01.08.2016 PASSED IN MVC NO.168/2016 ON THE FILE OF THE II ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND AMACT-8, SHIVAMOGGA, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR DISMISSAL, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT

WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE SMT.
JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI  ORAL ORDER
This appeal is of the year 2017 and even till now, the notice has not been issued to the respondents even for the first time.
2. Earlier, a cost Rs.500/- was imposed and no acknowledgment is filed for having paid the said cost.

When this matter came up before this Court on 01.04.2025, there was no representation on behalf of both the parties and the matter was directed to be listed under the caption for 'Dismissal'
today.
Today also, there is no representation on behalf of the appellants.
It appears that the appellants are not interested to pursue the matter.
3. Accordingly, the Miscellaneous First Appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
